## Description {#details}

Struct template representing a generic value, accessible via a getter.

<ParametersList title="Template Parameters">
<ParametersListItem name="T">The type of the value to be encapsulated.</ParametersListItem>
<ParametersListItem name="Unused">An optional parameter for SFINAE or specialisation, defaults to <code>int</code>.</ParametersListItem>
</ParametersList>
The <code>value</code> struct template encapsulates a value of type <code>T</code>, providing a consistent interface for value access and conversion. It inherits from <code><a href="/micro-test-plus-xpack/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/type-traits/op">type&#95;traits::op</a></code> to enable unified handling within the µTest++ framework&#39;s type traits and metaprogramming utilities.

This struct template exposes the value via a member variable, a getter method, and an explicit conversion operator. It is intended for use cases where a value must be wrapped and treated generically within the framework, supporting advanced template metaprogramming and type introspection.
